kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-full-nat-entry-attribute --full-nat-table-id fulltb-gw88z7hhlv43rmb260000 --full-nat-entry-id fullnat-gw8fz23jezpbblf1j0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyFullNatEntryAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the FULLNAT table to which the FULLNAT entry belongs
parameters.name: full_nat_table_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the FULLNAT entry to be modified
parameters.name: full_nat_entry_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs), also known as the network interface controller (NIC), to be modified
parameters.name: network_interface_id

parameters.help_en: The NAT IP address to be modified
parameters.name: nat_ip

parameters.help_en: The frontend port to be modified for FULLNAT port mapping. Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的FULLNAT端口映射的前端端口，取值：1~65535
parameters.name: nat_ip_port

parameters.help_en: The backend IP address to be modified for FULLNAT address translation
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的FULLNAT地址转换的后端IP地址
parameters.name: access_ip

parameters.help_en: The backend port to be modified for FULLNAT port mapping. Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的FULLNAT端口映射的后端端口，取值：1~65535
parameters.name: access_port

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of the Redirection Port. Valid values:

TCP: forwards TCP packets. 
UDP: forwards UDP packets
parameters.help_zh:
转发端口的协议类型，取值：

TCP：转发TCP协议的报文。 
UDP：转发UDP协议的报文
parameters.name: ip_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the FULLNAT entry.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的FULLNAT条目名称，即修改后的名称。

长度为2~128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: full_nat_entry_name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the FULLNAT entry.

The description can be empty or 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的FULLNAT条目的描述信息，即修改后的描述信息。

描述可以为空；或填写2~256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: full_nat_entry_description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without modifying the FULLNAT entry. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and the required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a Normal request. If the check succeeds, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the FULLNAT entry is modified
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改FULLNAT条目。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并修改FULLNAT条目
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC NAT gateway to which the FULLNAT entry belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的FULLNAT条目所在VPC NAT网关的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The backend domain name to be modified for FULLNAT address translation
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的 FULLNAT 地址转换的后端域名
parameters.name: access_domain
